examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The Observability band: Error rate, Status codes and Data streams, each shown by an illustration that fills the frame, with the button in the section title. A band with no tabs renders nothing at all.

examples.name: Code
examples.summary: Each tab opens a code file as its media: line numbers, lines that rise in while the tab is open, and a named copy button. When any tab carries `code` the stage grows to 30rem and draws the pixelate texture.

examples.name: Live scene
examples.summary: One `ConsoleMockup` drawn for every tab through the band `scene`: each tab hands its `value` to the widget as `tab`, so the console plays the agents, console or CLI beat of the open tab. The `autoplayInterval` holds each tab for six seconds.
